1.w: Finally, brothers, pray for us that the word of the Lord may run and may be glorified, just as also with you⁺,

2.w: and that we may be delivered from perverse and evil men; for the faith [is] not unto all.

3.w: But faithful is the Lord, who will strengthen you⁺ and guard [you] from the evil one.

4.w: And we are persuaded in the Lord as to you⁺, that both you⁺ are doing and you⁺ will do what we command.

5.w: And may the Lord direct your⁺ hearts into the love of God and into the perseverance of Christ.

6.w: Now we command you⁺, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to withdraw yourselves from every brother walking in an unruly manner and not according to the tradition that you received from us.

7.w: For you⁺ yourselves know how it is necessary to imitate us, because we were not unruly among you⁺,

8.w: nor did we eat bread from anyone without payment, but in labor and toil, working night and day in order not to be burdensome upon any of you⁺,

9.w: not that we do not have authority, but so that we might give ourselves [as] a pattern to you⁺ for you to imitate us.

10.w: For even when we were with you⁺, we were commanding you⁺ this, that “if anyone is not willing to work, neither let him eat.”

11.w: For we hear some are walking among you⁺ in an unruly manner, not working at all, but being busybodies.

12.w: Now to such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that, working with quietness, they should eat their own bread.

13.w: Now you⁺, brothers, should not grow weary [in] well-doing.

14.w: And if anyone does not obey our word through the letter, take note of this one not to mix with him, so that he may be ashamed.

15.w: And do not deem [him] as an enemy, but admonish [him] as a brother.

16.w: Now may the Lord of peace Himself give to you⁺ peace through everything in every way. The Lord [be] with all of you⁺.

17.w: The greeting [is] in my own hand—Paul, which is [my] sign in every letter. In this way I write.

18.w: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with all of you⁺.
